evidence: episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t1-s11-combined: move_to_pixel failed immediately with error_code outside_workspace; no control ticks were executed.
episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t3-s11-combined: initial and later move_to_pixel calls also failed with outside_workspace or target_not_reached, including errors of 0.087 m and 0.208 m.
memory.lesson: Pixel-selected targets can be unreachable or outside the workspace under yaw/low-light views; a plan must treat move_to_pixel failure as a hard branch and avoid issuing dependent actions as if contact occurred.
memory.title: Treat pixel reachability as unverified

evidence: episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t2-s11-combined: repeated move_relative forward actions succeeded at TCP level, but the episode ended decision_budget_exhausted with environment_success false.
episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t2-s11-combined: one contact_button move_to_pixel failed target_not_reached with 0.0176 m error before later attempts.
memory.lesson: Repeated small forward motions do not establish that a button was contacted or fully pressed; visual re-observation and a bounded retry policy are needed, with success judged from the final state rather than tool completion.
memory.title: Do not equate TCP motion with task completion

evidence: episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t3-s11-combined: set_gripper returned command closed with grasp_verified false.
episodes/cycle-1-discover/c1t3-s11-combined: later insertion attempts failed target_not_reached and the episode ended control_budget_exhausted.
memory.lesson: Gripper closure is not evidence of a grasp, and insertion should not be planned as though the peg is held; verify task-relevant object motion or use conservative bounded actions.
memory.title: Keep grasp status explicitly unverified

skills.description: Approach a visible puck surface and apply one controlled push displacement. The caller must supply a fresh visible puck pixel and observation ID; this sequence does not verify contact or target success.
skills.name: push_visible_target

skills.description: Reach a currently visible button surface and apply one inward displacement. Tool completion only reports TCP movement; the caller should inspect a later observation for button state.
skills.name: press_visible_button

skills.description: Attempt a conservative visible peg approach, close the gripper, and make one insertion displacement. Closure is not treated as grasp verification; use only when the target is reachable and insertion direction is appropriate.
skills.name: attempt_peg_insert
